questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in view (around 00:08-00:11), there are clearly three pens arranged in a row.

The left and right pens have a black cap at the bottom, pointing down. The middle pen does not have a black cap at the bottom; it appears to be a thin barrel, suggesting it is either uncapped (tip down) or flipped (cap up, though the top doesn't look like a cap). It is not aligned identically to the others.
The middle pen appears different in color/texture at the bottom compared to the black caps of the outer pens. It looks like a bare grey/translucent barrel.
The middle pen lacks the black cap visible on the other two pens. It looks shorter or just like a bare barrel, indicating a missing cap or exposed tip.
The board moves steadily from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is missing its black cap, unlike the left and right pens which are capped. This breaks the uniformity of the set.

description: One pen is missing its cap (variant).
